Hobart, TAS | $100,000 - $115,000 + Super

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically strong accountant looking to move beyond transactional reporting and step into a broader role with exposure to budgeting, forecasting, stakeholder engagement, leadership and commercial decision support.
Working closely with senior leaders, you'll play a key role in maintaining financial integrity, improving reporting processes and helping the business make informed decisions through quality financial analysis.

The Opportunity

Financial & Technical
  • Lead the preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial reporting.
  • Maintain the integrity of the general ledger, reconciliations and financial controls.
  • Manage statutory compliance including BAS, FBT, Payroll Tax and other reporting obligations.
  • Support year-end processes and act as a key contact for auditors and external stakeholders.
  • Assist with cashflow forecasting, budgeting and financial planning activities.
Operational
  • Analyse financial performance and provide meaningful variance analysis and recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting, controls, systems and finance processes.
  • Support finance-related projects, automation initiatives and continuous improvement activities.
  • Investigate and resolve financial discrepancies and reporting issues.
Stakeholder & Commercial
  • Partner with operational managers and non-finance stakeholders to provide financial insights and support decision-making.
  • Prepare reporting packs and financial commentary for leadership teams.
  • Provide guidance and support to junior finance team members.
  • Contribute to building a high-performing and collaborative finance function.

To be successful, you'll ideally bring:
  • CA or CPA qualified (or actively studying towards completion)
  • Experience preparing financial statements, reconciliations and management reporting.
  • Exposure to budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis.
  • Strong understanding of financial controls and statutory compliance requirements.
  • Experience working with ERP systems and advanced Excel.
  • The confidence to engage with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  • A proactive mindset with a genuine interest in improving systems, processes and reporting.
Why Apply?
  • Genuine opportunity to grow into a larger leadership role.
  • Broad exposure across financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and business partnering.
  • Stable and well-regarded Tasmanian organisation.
  • Supportive leadership team focused on development.
  • Strong organisational culture with long-term career opportunities.
  • Opportunity to influence systems, reporting and process improvements.
Salary

$100,000 - $115,000 + Super

  • Service Excellence: Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner. communication behaviors.
 
Additional information:

Pub Banc Group Impacted Employee - Rapid Response Skills Initiative (RRSI) & Career Connector Registration 
 
Register here for Career Connector support to access the Rapid Response Skills Initiative (RRSI) that provides up to $3,000 of funding for Training for employees impacted by business closure, downsizing or retrenchment. 

Funded by the Tasmanian Government, Jobs Tasmania.

That training could be for Re-skilling, Work Related Tickets and Certifications to support and enhance the employability of workers that have been made redundant within the last 12 months. 

The Career Connector service will connect you to personalised Career Support to improve your employability with access to RRSI funded training and a Free Jobs Matching Service.  Career Connector provides advice with Training, connects you to the Network of Regional Local Jobs Hubs, relevant Service Providers and supports you into Employment Opportunities to re-establish your career. 
 
To be eligible, you must meet all of the below criteria: 
  • have lost Casual, Full-time or Part-time work in the last 12 months due to Business Closure, Business Downsizing or Retrenchment
  • be an Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident with a Tasmanian Residential address
  • provide written evidence of job loss, redundancy or retrenchment (a Separation Certificate indicating Redundancy or Email/ Written Evidence of Redundancy)
  • If you were employed by Local, State or Australian Government or Government Department, Business or Government Enterprise, you may not be eligible for RRSI funded training.
